seatedToss.guidance: Hlalani etafuleni, nishintjane nikhandze ingwebu lelithambile etarijethini lelikhulu. Gcinani kubala ngetiphepha, ndzawonye.
steps: Phrintani itarijethi nephepha lekubala, bese nilibeka phansi etafuleni phakatsi kwenu.
Hlalani ngekuphumula, umuntfu ngalinye ngakhatsi. Nitfutse ngekuphindzana nikhandze kancane, noma nidlulise uma ningatsandzi.
Lapho ingwebu lehla ekhatsini, umuntfu lokhandzile umake ibhokisi linye ekholomini yakhe, emgceni walelikhatsi.
Bukani emamaka ndzawonye nakuphela, uma nifisa. Akekho lodzingeka kubala lutfo.
Yekani noma nini lapho umuntfu afuna kuyeka.
seatedToss.safetyLine: Sebentisani ingwebu lelinemboze lelifakwe ngentfumbu noma sokisi lelikhishwe, hlalani phansi, ningatsi khandzi ebusweni, futsi ube nemuntfu lomdzala lasedzutsini. Tintfo letincane tingaba yingozi yekuphanyeka.
safety: Khethani ingwebu lelinemboze lelifakwe ngentfumbu, noma khuntsani sokisi lelihlanzekile. Ngaphambi kwekusebentisa, hlolani kutsi kute timbobo noma tindzandzisi letilulekile, kuze kungaphumi lutfo.
Ubhontshisi, lilayisi nalokunye lokugcwele lokuncane tingaba yingozi yekuphanyeka. Tigcinani kude nebantfwana labancane nakubo bonkhe labafaka tintfo emilonyeni.
Hlalani siduze kangangekutsi ningafinyelela, futsi londvolotani ngekucophelela uma kukhona lingafaka emlonyeni.
Hlalani phansi. Khandzani kancane uye etarijethini etafuleni phansi, ningatsi uye ebusweni.
seatedToss.previewLabel: Liphepha lelifakiwe: itarijethi lenemakhatsi lamatsatfu lebitwa Eduze, Maphakathi naKude, kusuka ngaphandle kuye ngaphakathi, nekubala lenekholomu yemuntfu ngamunye nemigca yemabhokisi lalingenalutfo lelikhatsi ngalinye.
seatedToss.sheetHow: Beketani liphepha phansi phakatsi kwenu. Ingwebu lebhalela ekhatsini, faka umake ebhokisini lelisekholomini yenu, emgceni walelikhatsi.

seasonalPack.restLine: Akukho mimdlalo namuhla. Lilanga lekuphumula nalo lilanga lelihle.

decorateACard.guidance: Khetsani umcimbi, bese nihlobisa likhadi ndzawonye ngetikhalara noma ngemapeni. Akukho likhadi lelilungile.

steps.fold: Phrintani likhadi bese niyagoca kubili ngemugca lowenteke tindzibhi, kuze indzawo yaphambili ibe ngaphandle.
steps.front: Umuntfu munye uhlobisa indzawo yaphambili, ajikeleta emagama.
steps.inside: Lomunye umuntfu uhlobisa indzawo yemuva, noma nishintjane kulehlangotsi linye.
steps.message: Bhalani umlayeto ndzawonye. Umuntfu munye angabhala, lomunye asho emagama.
steps.stop: Yekani noma nini lapho nifisa khona. Akukho likhadi lelilungile ngempela, futsi lelilula linjalo lilungile.

decorateACard.materials: Sebentisani tikhalara, tipensela letinemibala noma mapeni. Akukho lodzingeka kusikwa noma kunamatelwa.
decorateACard.previewLabel: Kubukwa kwelikhadi leligotiwe kubili. Indzawo yaphambili ifundza {words}, nelirhalo lelilula lemahlamvu netinkanyezi. Indzawo yemuva inemigca yemlayeto nemugca we-Kusuka.
decorateACard.sheetHow: Phindvuta likhadi ngalo mugca wetimamaki, lifake lingaphandle liphambi. Bhala umlayetfo ngemuva.
sheetRules: Shintsanani, noma nihlukanise umsebenti: lomunye ahlobise liphambi, lomunye ngemuva.
Bhalani umlayetfo ndzawonye, noma umuntfu mnye abhale loshiwo ngulomunye.
Noma ngubani angayeka nanoma nini. Kute likhadi lelilungile.

scrapbook.guidance: Phendvula emakhasi ndzawonye, ngetinkinobho noma ngetinkinobho tekhibhodi letikhomba ngakwesobunxele nangakwesokudla. Engeta emagama ambalwa ngaphansi kwesithombe uma ufisa. Lokwentiwe akulondvolotwa noma kutfunyelwe.
scrapbook.lookGuidance: Bukani ngalinye lemakhasi ndzawonye. Ningakhuluma noma nibukele nje.
scrapbook.intro: Khetsa tithombe letimbili kuya kulishumi nemibili kulesi sitfuli. Ngalinye lilibe likhasi lencwadzi lengephendvula ndzawonye.

scrapbook.privacy: Tithombe takho tisala kuleso sitfuli. Atilayishwa noma atilondvolotwa.
scrapbook.cleared: Incwadzi isuswe. Khetsa tithombe kuze uqale kabusha.
scrapbook.captionHelp: Kufika ku-80 tinhlamvu. Emagama ahlala kulelikhasi kuphela, futsi ayanyamalala uma uvala.
scrapbook.sheetHow: Sithombe sinye ngekhasi, namagama asengcenyeni. Phendvula emakhasi ngalokulandzelana, futsi nikhulume ngalinye.

quietScene.guidance: Bukani sithombe sinye ngalesikhatsi. Cinya Lalandzelako noma Lalangaphambili nawusulungele. Akukho lonyakaza ngekwakhe.

collageBoard.guidance: Phendvulana. Thinta lesikhishwe, bese uthinta indzawo lengenalutfo kuze ukubeke lapho. Akukho lokwentiwe lolondvolotwa noma kutfunyelwe.

collageBoard.filled: Indzawo {n} sele inesithombe. Khetsa indzawo lengenalutfo.

collageBoard.anotherSet: Sete lesisha setincucu sisetreyini. Tincucu lesisebhodini sihlala lapho sesikhona.
collageBoard.sheetHow: Sika tithombe bese niphendvulana kuzibeka ebhodini. Umuntu losekhulile angasika.

gardenPlanner.guidance: Thinta sithombe, bese uthinta libhede kuze usibeke lapho. Thinta libhede lolunesithombe, kungakhethwa lutfo, kuze ulisule.
gardenPlanner.needPicture: Khetha sitfombe kucala, bese ucindzetela lilima.
gardenPlanner.cleared: Lilima {n} alingenalutfo. Lubuyisele uma ufuna sitfombe lesifanako futsi.
gardenPlanner.sheetHow: Emalima akhombisa emifanekiso lekhethwe kusikrini. Dvweba emalimini lasetulu uma ufisa.
gardenPlanner.notice: Lesi luhlelo lwemifanekiso lwekukhuluma ngaso, hhayi seluleko sekutjala.

coloringWall.guidance: Khetha sitfombe kanye nenani lemakhasi. Phrinta lodzonga, bese umuntu ngamunye afaka umbala emakhasini lilanga limbe noma lamaningi. Akukho sikhatsi lesibalwako, emaphuzu noma kugcinwa.
coloringWall.previewLabel: {picture|lower} lehlukaniswe ibe emakhasini {n}, {across} ngebanga na {down} ngaphansi. Likhasi ngalinye linelebula ekhoneni lalo.
coloringWall.previewCaption: Sitfombe nemigca yemakhasi nemalebula ladzwetjwe kuso.
coloringWall.labelsNote: Emalitha ahamba ngaphansi kwelodzonga, kanti emanombolo ahamba ngebanga, kutsi A1 yikhasi lelisekhoneni lelingentasi lelisetulu.
steps: Phrinta onkhe emakhasi. Likhasi lekucala linemacondvo lalesi nemephu yalodzonga.
Umuntu ngamunye khetsa likhasi linye noma lamaningi ufake umbala.
Imibala nemitindzo akudzingeki ifane. Onkhe emakhasi ayingxenye yalesitfombe sinye.
Hlela emakhasi ngetilebula tawo, bese uyahlanganisa ngetepu ngemuva.
Yiphakamise lodzonga endzaweni lapho onkhe umuntu angayibona khona.
coloringWall.mapLabel: Imephu yalodzonga: imigca {down}, ilinye ngalinye linemakhasi {across}, alebhulwe kusukela ku-A1 kuya ku-{last}.
coloringWall.edgeNote: Umugca lolunetindzawo letincane ukhombisa umphetfo wekhasi ngalinye. Hlela emakhasi econdza emphetfweni wawo, noma uwuvalele lincane.
coloringWall.pictureLine: Sitfombe: {picture}. Lodzonga linemakhasi {n}: {across} ngebanga na {down} ngaphansi.

colorWash.keys: Tikhiye temicibisholo tihambisa lilunga lebhurashi ekhasini. Sipheshi sicala noma simisa burashi.

calmBreathing.guidance: Phefumula ngesikhatsi indilinga ikhula, bese uphefumula ngaphandle ngesikhatsi incane. Iyayeka yodwa ngemva kwemakhefu lasitfupha.
calmBreathing.started: Siqalile. Phefumula ngaphakatsi njengoba indilinga ikhula.
calmBreathing.finished: Lokho bekungemakhefu lasitfupha lakahle. Qala futsi nangabe ufuna.

storyChain.guidance: Shintshanani: umusho munye ngamunye, futsi engeta sithombe lesilandzelako.

storyChain.full: Iketanisi selinetithombe letitsatfu tonkhe. Tsatsani indzaba yonkhe, noma nicale iketanisi lelisha.

cards.prompt: Sitshele ngepayi yesithelo noma ngedeseti oyitsandzako.
Yini lenta sidla sasekuseni lesihle kakhulu?
Kumnandzi noma kumuncu: yiphi lotsandza kakhulu?
Sitshele ngendlu oyitsandzako lapho wake wahlala khona.
Tikati noma tinja, noma kute? Yini lotsandza ngato?
Yiphi tinyoni tobona noma tokwetfula ngaphandle?
Ukhe wadoba tinhlanti noma wagcina intangi yetinhlanti?
Ungathanda kuchitha lilanga elwandle noma etintabeni?
Uma ungandiza phezu kwanoma yiphi indzawo, ibe kuphi?
Yiseluleko siphi longasipha umuntfu lomncane lotsandza kuqala umsebenti?
Yini lenta liphathi libe lihle ngempela?
Yiliphi lividiyo noma luhlelo lwetelevishini lotsandza kubuka futsi?
Sinowu, imvula noma lilanga: yiphi lotsandza?
